name: yukibana
description: An online Swift IDE where the compiler and the compiled program are both WebAssembly

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @yukibana/runtime && npm run build --workspace @yukibana/theia-extension
scripts.build:ide: npm run build -w @yukibana/runtime && npm run build -w @yukibana/theia-extension && npm run build:prod -w @yukibana/ide
scripts.deploy:ide: npm run build:ide && npm run stage:ide && wrangler deploy -c packages/ide/wrangler.jsonc
